topic: Animals and the food they eat
key_concepts: Animals can be grouped according to the food they eat.
Herbivores are animals that eat plants only.
Carnivores are animals that eat meat only.
Omnivores are animals that eat both plants and animals.
Predators hunt and kill other animals; prey are hunted and killed.
Examples of herbivores include cows, carabaos, green sea turtles, dugongs, and parrotfish.
Examples of carnivores include lions, sharks, wolves, snakes, hawks, and crocodiles.
Herbivores have body structures and adaptations that help them get and eat plant food.
Carnivores have features such as sharp teeth, talons, and keen eyes that help them hunt.
Some herbivores like parrotfish help coral reefs stay healthy by eating algae.
